name: Grilled Paneer Millet Bowl
ingredients: ½ cup uncooked foxtail millet, cooked (1½ cups cooked)
Dressing: 1 tsp olive oil, juice of ½ lemon, ½ tsp each oregano and chilli flakes
1 tbsp pumpkin seeds, optional (omit for seed allergies)
steps: Cook the millet in 1½ cups water for 12–15 minutes, drain, and fluff.
Brush the paneer and zucchini with the olive oil and grill in a hot pan for 3 minutes per side.
Divide the millet between two bowls; add the paneer, zucchini and tomato.
Drizzle with the dressing and season.
note: Millets add fibre and a lower glycaemic load than polished rice; half the grain portion keeps carbohydrates moderate.
